name: Yoshitsune Eiyuu-den: The Story of Hero Yoshitsune
summary: Yoshitsune Eiyuu-den: The Story of Hero Yoshitsune is a historical action game set during Japan’s late Heian period and the Genpei War. Based on the real-life campaigns of the legendary 11th-century samurai Minamoto no Yoshitsune, it combines third-person 3D combat with real-time strategy in large-scale turf-war battles across Japan. Players fight directly, command troops, capture territory, and guide their forces safely across the battlefield.
